meta.index.title: Galac6 — AI in the service of teaching · Tutoring from 1st to 12th grade
meta.index.description: Galac6 is an AI learning assistant built on the French national curriculum: quizzes, dictations, revision sheets, mock brevet and bac exams. Designed in France, data hosted in France. From 1st to 12th grade.
meta.index.og_title: Galac6. AI in the service of teaching
meta.index.og_description: Quizzes, dictations, revision sheets, mock brevet and bac exams. The AI that teaches pupils how to learn, on the French national curriculum, from 1st to 12th grade.
meta.ecole.title: Galac6 for schools: huge time savings for your teachers, tailored follow-up of every pupil
meta.ecole.description: Galac6 for primary and secondary schools: homework and corrections prepared by AI, follow-up of every class and every pupil, didactic AI, parents involved, data hosted in France. Free 3-month pilot on 3 classes, pricing on quote.
meta.ecole.og_title: Galac6: the AI that saves time for your whole school
meta.ecole.og_description: Galac6 takes care of the repetitive work so your teachers can focus on what matters. Free 3-month pilot on 3 classes, pricing on quote.
meta.about.title: About Galac6 — Our educational mission
meta.about.description: Galac6's mission: make AI tutoring accessible to everyone, with a didactic approach that makes pupils think. A French EdTech, from 1st to 12th grade.
meta.about.og_description: Making AI tutoring accessible to everyone, with a didactic approach. A French EdTech.
meta.tarifs.title: Galac6 — Pricing: Discovery, Student, Family and schools on quote
meta.tarifs.description: Galac6 pricing: the Discovery plan to try it in limited amounts, the Student plan at €69 a year or €7.99 a month, the Family plan for up to 4 children at €99 a year or €11.99 a month, the Exam Pack at €19. For schools: pricing on quote and a free 3-month pilot.
meta.tarifs.og_description: The Discovery plan to try it, Student at €69 a year, Family at €99 a year for up to 4 children. For schools, pricing on quote.
gen.notice: Galac6 follows the French national curriculum today. The app is in French, and its interface is also available in English. Would you like Galac6 adapted to your country? Vote for your country: we will adapt it to the countries that ask for it most.

faq.a11: Galac6 is built on the French national curriculum, so it already works for pupils and schools that follow it, wherever they are. The app is in French, and its interface is also available in English. If your school follows another curriculum, vote for your country: we will adapt Galac6 to the countries that ask for it most.
